evaluator.limits: NUL-containing and non-UTF8 byte strings are deliberately excluded from the ordinary JSON evaluator channel, not from native/runtime comparison. No byte-wide evaluator equivalence is claimed.

host.locale: C enforced for every child; native driver additionally calls setlocale(LC_ALL, C)
host.high_byte_scope: All 256 byte values are probed, including equal high bytes and bytes adjacent to digits. This is empirical evidence for these exact binaries/libraries in the C locale, not portable C++ signed-char equivalence. Passing a negative signed char other than EOF to isdigit is undefined by the C standard unless converted to unsigned char; this harness does not establish the upstream cast/compiler details or all libc behavior. ldd identifies resolved dependencies, not a captured live process map. Host getconf libc and native-linked libc can differ; inspect both recorded identities.
